journal_lines: Paused at a moss-covered stone. Strange marks. Sat with it a long while before moving on.
Inscription on the rock face. Old enough that the stone had grown into it. Stayed and looked.
Found it in a clearing. Marks cut deep. Something meaningful about them. Rested here.
Rock face with repeated symbols. Not recent. Sat with it a while.
The inscription ran too long to copy. Memorized the middle section.
Marks around the base of an old tree. Someone else sat here before.
A stone placed deliberately in the stream. Carved marks worn almost smooth.
The inscription was in a cave wall at knee height. Strange choice. Sat to read it.
Whatever it meant, the effort that went into carving it was not casual. Paid attention.
Old marks on the cliff face. The weather had worked on them. Still legible in parts.
Found them by running a paw across the stone. Felt them before I saw them.
Sat with it until the light changed. Something resolved. Continued.
